request.style: English, young female solo voice with gentle choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, soft flute, warm strings, joyful and steady mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She sent for Barak son of Abinoam
From Kedesh in Naphtali to go
Go, march to Mount Tabor now
Take ten thousand men to flow

[Chorus]
Rise up, Barak, and lead away
Your captives, son of Abinoam
The LORD has gone out before you
Victory is the way

[Verse]
Sisera heard he went up
Nine hundred iron chariots run
To the Kishon River side
The troops were gathered wide

[Chorus]
Rise up, Barak, and lead away
Your captives, son of Abinoam
The LORD has gone out before you
Victory is the way

[Bridge]
Earth shook when He went from Seir
Heavens poured and mountains stirred
Sinai melted before His face
A mighty and holy grace

[Verse]
Barak charged down from the hill
Ten thousand men, strong and still
The LORD routed Sisera’s force
By the sword, a fierce course

[Chorus]
Rise up, Barak, and lead away
Your captives, son of Abinoam
The LORD has gone out before you
Victory is the way

[Outro]
Awake, awake, break into song
Sing to the LORD, right and strong
Son of Abinoam, blessed name
In the heart of Israel’s flame
